body:
Directly continues selfhost/lexer.prn + selfhost/parser.prn. New selfhost/region.prn: a real, faithful PARENA-language port of src/region.c (VS0's own DoD-domain-2 checker: a single-pass symbol-table walk enforcing the assignment invariant, Region(Source) >= Region(Destination), over the parser's own real Node AST). Real design departures: no linked Scope-with-a-parent-pointer chain -- VS0 has no way to store a reference type as a struct field, so the whole scope is ONE flat (Vec Binding) @ Region, most-recently-pushed bindings scanned first; entering a child scope copies every existing binding into a fresh Vec before adding the new one(s). Found and fixed 3 more real bugs: (1) a match nested as a VALUE inside a non-tail if/cond branch doesn't compile -- a real, deep architectural gap (match's own value production is statement-shaped, incompatible with being embedded in a single C ternary; a general fix would need GCC's own statement-expression extension, incompatible with -std=c99 -pedantic) -- worked around by extracting every such match into its own small function. (2) An Ok-bound raw (Vec T) Result payload doesn't get its own element type resolved -- worked around via a ScopeResult wrapper struct, matching LexStep/ParseStep's own established pattern. (3) A genuine LOGIC bug in this file's own first draft, not the compiler: walk-let-bindings seeded its accumulator from an empty Vec instead of a copy of the outer scope, silently losing every outer binding the moment a let was entered -- found via a real minimal debug harness after the DoD's own required negative test case came back a false negative, fixed with a new scope-copy helper. 9 real assertions in tests/test_selfhost_region.c, EVERY ONE lifted directly from tests/test_region.c's own real test suite (identical inputs against an independent implementation, including an exact match on the DoD's own required error message string). Full local suite + bazel build/test + real mingw cross-compile all clean, zero regressions. CI green on all 4 platform jobs. NORTHSTAR.md's own Self-hosting section extended. PARENA commit d4b30e8, release v0.87.0.

⚓ ☃
title: v0.87.0: real third step toward a self-hosted PARENA compiler -- region.prn
